text: I want to find out how long passenger boarding takes on average. Create an event log containing the start and end of passenger boarding for each boarding session.
I'd like to understand how long individual ground-handling jobs take, regardless of the type of work. Reconstruct the lifecycle of each job. Focus on actual work execution.

Where are the bottlenecks in the final stages of departure preparation, from boarding to off-block? For each outbound flight, include boarding start and close, confirmed closure of the baggage loading operation, aircraft readiness and actual off-block departure.

Where is time lost during aircraft turnarounds? For each turnaround, build an event log covering actual inbound arrival movements, the overall start of ground handling, completion of every ground service, boarding start and close, aircraft readiness, and actual outbound departure movements, from inbound landing to outbound take-off.

For each turnaround, include the overall start of ground handling, completion of cabin cleaning and refuelling, and aircraft readiness. I want to see how cleaning and refuelling fit into the preparation process.
I want to understand how long it takes to get a flight away once boarding starts. For each outbound flight, include boarding start and close, actual off-block departure and take-off.

I want to review the ground services that prepared each outbound flight. Include completion of baggage unloading from the arriving aircraft, cabin cleaning, refuelling, catering loading and baggage loading during the turnaround that prepared the flight.
Trace the actual aircraft movements from arrival to the next departure for each turnaround. Include only arrival and departure movement milestones, from inbound landing to outbound take-off.
How long do departures following a turnaround take from leaving the stand to take-off? Create an event log of actual off-block and take-off events.

I want to review the boarding-to-departure sequence for each flight on each operating date, without grouping flights that share the same flight number. Include boarding start, boarding close and actual off-block departure for each outbound flight.
I'd like to compare boarding durations across boarding sessions. Create an event log of the session-level boarding lifecycle, rather than individual passengers' boarding actions.

How does boarding progress into take-off for departures following a turnaround? Build an event log containing only flight-level boarding milestones and actual departure movements, from the beginning of boarding to take-off.
